admission.justification: Metadata persistence, image storage and live store error state jointly preserve the collection and make reload loss explicit, with reload and refused-write tests.

applicability: The kept tray data for one dashboard browser origin, including admitted pasted-image picks.
conditions: localStorage keeps valid pick metadata, notes, free text and targets; restored reference keys are recomputed from their identity.
Image bytes are keyed by digest in IndexedDB, with the current image store also retaining its live in-memory bytes.
Storage refusal keeps the in-memory collection and reports that it will not survive reload; removing failed image picks can clear their persistence warning.
exclusions: Open/minimised presentation is not part of kept collection data.
No reload survival is promised after storage refusal.
Pasted image files are distinct from display capture or DOM screenshot rendering.
